package fixture

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/2comjie/nova/rpc"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/emptypb"
)

type Request = emptypb.Empty
type Response = emptypb.Empty

type sampleService struct { fail bool }
func (s sampleService) Unary(context.Context, *Request) (*Response, *rpc.Error) {
	if s.fail { return nil, rpc.NewError(1001, "rejected") }
	return &Response{}, nil
}

func TestGeneratedService(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct { name string; service SampleServer; code uint32 }{
		{"success", sampleService{}, 0},
		{"business error", sampleService{fail:true}, 1001},
		{"unimplemented", UnimplementedSampleServer{}, rpc.CodeNotFound},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := rpc.NewServer()
			RegisterSampleServer(server, UnimplementedSampleServer{})
			RegisterSampleServer(server, test.service)
			listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			done := make(chan error, 1)
			go func() { done <- server.Serve(listener) }()
			defer func() {
				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
				defer cancel()
				if err := server.Shutdown(ctx); err != nil { t.Error(err) }
				if err := <-done; err != nil && err != rpc.ErrClosed { t.Error(err) }
			}()
			conn := rpc.NewConn(listener.Addr().String())
			defer conn.Close()
			client := NewSampleClient(conn)
			response, err := client.Unary(t.Context(), &Request{})
			if test.code == 0 {
				if err != nil || response == nil { t.Fatalf("response=%v err=%v", response, err) }
			} else {
				var failure *rpc.Error
				if !errors.As(err, &failure) || failure.Code != test.code { t.Fatalf("error=%v", err) }
			}
		})
	}
}
